name: How much does crown molding installation typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does crown molding installation typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crown molding costs depend primarily on linear footage, the profile selected, ceiling height, and whether painting is bundled. Material choices range from budget-friendly MDF and primed pine to solid hardwoods. Additional cost factors include addressing uneven drywall, framing irregular corners, and high or vaulted ceilings that require extra staging. Because finish carpentry, drywall repairs, and interior painting can be performed by the same in-house team at HH Remodeling, combining molding installation with wall painting or drywall touch-ups often lowers overall labor expenses compared to hiring separate trade contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary by linear footage, molding material, ceiling height, and room complexity. Bundling carpentry with interior painting under one contractor often keeps total project costs lower.
